title: They Fight
plot_overview: A reformed ex-convict returns home hoping to rebuild his family, but finds a new purpose at a boxing gym in a Washington, D.C., youth center facing closure. Working with a veteran coach, he mentors young boxers preparing for a major tournament while helping them navigate friendship, ambition, and tough choices.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy heartfelt underdog sports dramas centered on mentorship, community, and second chances; Not for you if you want unconventional plotting or a story focused mainly on adult competition.
review_summary: Pros: uplifting mentorship; emotional stakes; youth boxing focus | Cons: familiar sports-drama beats; limited critical context
